scope: Wave6R2 evaluation only; not promoted to a global Kiln Gate or Capability manifest.
supersedes: provider-contracts.v1.json (frozen by holdout.v1.json; preserved as Arsenal knowledge)

asymmetry.rule: sound_for_failure providers must not be invoked on pass-adjudication paths
asymmetry.rule_2: sound_for_pass providers must not be invoked on failure-adjudication paths

absence_of_counterexample.rule: providers must not issue negative-absence claims without explicit exhaustiveness proof

required_conditions: exact added parameter binding can be resolved

supported_claim_kinds: newly added parameter is reachable from its function body or from a same-patch test
assumptions: TypeScript compiler API binding resolution available
exact parameter binding identity is determinable from AST
providers.positive_guarantee_meaning: Observation identifies executable references with high empirical accuracy but no universal completeness claim
providers.negative_guarantee_meaning: Refutation holds only within the supported_domain; outside supported_domain → UNKNOWN
unknown_triggers: function/parameter not resolvable from provided source
limitations: dynamic dispatch (generic types, indirect destructuring, polymorphic calls) cannot be traced
does not prove universal reachability in future patches
does not validate binder-correctness outside the provided TypeScript source; supported_domain is a binding-identity claim bounded to function_body

outside_semantics_policy.reason: if the parameter is not bound by an authoritative contract, the contribution is inconclusive with unknown dynamic dispatch or unsupported language

supported_claim_kinds: selected command tuple equals registered tuple for the same command_id under the same repository_profile
assumptions: patched change does not alter the registry map
the selected command_id resolves to a tuple whose {executable, argv} fields are byte-identical to the registry entry
providers.scope: selected inputs — only the specific command_id whose registry identity is being compared
limitations: does not prove the runtime Command exits 0
does not prove absence of shell interpretation
does not validate argv semantics beyond identity
without constant-folding / binding analysis, cannot trace argv literal indirection

outside_semantics_policy.reason: if command_id is not in the registry, the Contribution is not_applicable and the Claim state is unsupported

providers.absence_of_counterexample_requirement: any negative-absence Claim (e.g. 'no unsupported command_id exists') requires explicit registry-scan termination

supported_claim_kinds: record_digest field is in the recognized fixture-marker namespace
assumptions: the registered fixture-marker set is finite and versioned (v0)
providers.scope: changed paths — the patched fixture file
limitations: does not validate runtime QMR semantics
does not prove digest content matches fixture body

outside_semantics_policy.reason: if the file is not under loadout/fixtures/** and is not referenced from plan.ts:51, no obligation is instantiated

supported_claim_kinds: every spawn call touched by the change uses argv-as-array and shell:false
assumptions: spawn call sites are reachable via static AST
the registered-Command model forbids shell interpretation unconditionally
providers.scope: selected symbols — the patched spawn call sites
limitations: dynamic dispatch chains (helpers that build args lists) cannot be statically traced
if the AST is unavailable (parse failure), the Contribution is inconclusive
without interprocedural dataflow, cannot trace argv through helper builders

outside_semantics_policy.reason: if the changed function does not call spawn/exec/execFile, no obligation is instantiated
